notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.72.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Bang co them cot "Dinh hang muc" (chon Level + offset mm) va cot "Chieu cao" cho tung Property Line co ky hieu HM. Chu mau cam = chua ghi vao moc. - Goi y dinh: diem cao nhat cua mai nam trong duong ranh, quy ve Level gan nhat (khong co mai thi lay tuong, cot, dam, san). Day chi la goi y - kiem tra va sua dong sai truoc khi ghi. - Nut "Ghi ky hieu HM": lan bam dau ghi ky hieu va hien goi y; bam lan nua thi tu gan ky hieu + Top Level cho moc
